|game_text=Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your total ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4), the PC website card list text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013). It is not the current text. The current text is [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-90E-Tusken_Breath_Mask-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Tusken Breath Mask (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 10, slip 90E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-90E-Tusken_Breath_Mask.png]]) prints slip number “90E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “your ability” to “your total ability” (the card-list entry is marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”, but the 7 December 2009 release sheet still prints the original text): “Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your total ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.”.<ref name="cl-1240_92-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-tuskenbreathmask-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual4-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/tuskenbreathmask.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual4-Light) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock4-Light/large/tuskenbreathmask.gif</ref>: “Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 4 set mark) and prints the number “90E” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 30), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30, page 30. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-92-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right.
